prompt: Create one production-ready transparent PNG game title logo for an existing colorful casual mobile puzzle game, GemLoopSort. Asset only, no background scene, no mockup. Text must read exactly "GemLoopSort", with capital G L S and no spaces, colon, tagline, or additional words. Spell it G e m L o o p S o r t. Large highly legible, friendly rounded chunky dimensional lettering in a SINGLE unified horizontal wordmark, approximately 2.6:1 overall composition; tightly crop the logo artwork with a little safe transparent padding. Visual style: polished soft 3D cartoon toy illustration, bevelled letters, smooth edges, luminous cream highlights, subtle plum-colored extrusion and warm shadow; avoid harsh black outlines. Gem in bright turquoise/jade with subtle gem-cut facets, LoopSort in rich golden orange with warm ivory lit faces. A compact cluster of three faceted blue, green, and red cubic gems rises above the left-middle letters; a small curved turquoise conveyor loop elegantly underlines the word and ends in a tiny red mining cart on the right, carrying one golden square gem. Integrate these motifs into the silhouette, keep the entire word easily readable even at mobile width. Tiny amber lava glow accents suggest volcanic mining, but no large flames, scenery, badges, rectangular plaque, or excessive ornament. Fits a vibrant volcanic canyon game with red and blue minecarts and a turquoise conveyor, soft colorful square blocks. The typography should dominate 80 percent of the logo. Warm joyful premium casual puzzle game branding, equally appealing to women and men. Actual alpha transparent background, no checkerboard, no solid background, no watermark.
